# Plan: statusline-refresh

Goal: Stop sofar disowning its own statusline: refreshInterval is the documented fix for a frozen idle line (Claude Code re-runs the command only on session start / new message / compact / mode toggle), but adding it makes isSofarStatusline's exact-2-key test fail, so install reports 'kept' and uninstall reports 'foreign' on sofar's own entry. Ship refreshInterval in the installed entry and widen the identity test to tolerate that one tunable key, keeping the theirs-wins law for genuinely foreign lines and keeping legacy 2-key installs removable.
